answer: Tie every claim to an anchor it cannot move: the agent must name a public checkpoint that predates the work by several epochs, and peers verify the checkpoint independently, so a fabricated record has no valid place to attach. Work then has to grow like timber, one ring per epoch of continuous presence, and a head that skips a ring must start a new trunk rather than resume the old one. Rewards bloom like lotus only on a completed ring, which means a fleet must sustain every identity in parallel across many epochs instead of spinning up disposable ones.
